_comment: Template settings.json — replace <YOUR_HOME> with your actual home path. The hook commands below use the Windows 'py' launcher; on macOS/Linux change them to 'python3' first. Only the hooks/agents shipped in this template are wired here; the original setup also had two personal/unrelated hooks (a reminder-flag script and a game-specific nudge) that are intentionally NOT included. The graphify-auto-update.py PostToolUse hook is a safe no-op if you haven't installed graphify (it checks for a graphify-out/graph.json before doing anything) — keep it wired or delete the PostToolUse block, your call. The permissions.ask block forces a real permission prompt before editing your own Claude Code config files (.claude/**, CLAUDE.md, .mcp.json) even in Auto Mode — without it, Auto Mode's own safety classifier may silently re-block those edits instead of asking.
